description:
Cast Flash putting Protean Hulk into play and choose not to pay.
Protean Hulk is sacrificed.
Grab Vigean Graftmage, Incubation Druid, & Torch Courier.
Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability triggers, move a counter to Incubation Druid.
Sacrifice Torch Courier to give Incubation Druid haste.
Tap Incubation Druid for {U}{U}{U} and untap it with Vigean Graftmage, netting {U}.
Repeat for infinite {U}.
You can now untap Incubation Druid as much as you want to get infinite of your other colors.
